source.name: SSPX 1962 ordo
source.publisher: Society of St Pius X, District of the USA

fields.name: the office's English name (for readable divergence reports; not compared)
fields.klasse: liturgical class parsed from the German localisation, 1 (highest) .. 4, or null when absent upstream
fields.particular: true when upstream tags the day "(FSSPX)" — an SSPX particular observance

notes: SSPX is a particular calendar (universal 1962 base plus its own observances). Colour and commemoration counts are not exposed by the feed, so they are not compared. Class is compared where parsed; days without a parsed class are skipped (a documented allowance).
